# Support

SkillRoll requires Python 3.12 or later. The Python package is tested on
Linux, macOS, and Windows. The composite GitHub Action and generated workflow
support Linux runners and GitHub only.

Inference uses an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint configured in
`skillroll.toml`. SkillRoll does not provide provider account support or
named-provider adapters.

For help, open a GitHub issue and include the SkillRoll version, Python
version, operating system, command, and redacted diagnostic output. Do not
include keys, provider headers, private prompts, private repository content, or
unreviewed run evidence.
